Seabass anonymized library export
==================================

Seabass version: 0.5 (beta)
Host OS: Linux
Hardware (as entered by the submitter): generated from Sebas's real whaleshark SD card, 2026-08-31
Notes (as entered by the submitter): committed integration-test fixture for the Seabass test suite

rekordbox:
Tracks kept: 1370
Tracks dropped (--max-tracks): 0
Distinct artists renamed: 738
Playlists/folders renamed: 20

Engine:
Tracks kept: 1376
Tracks dropped (--max-tracks): 0
Playlists/folders renamed: 20

What's included vs. stripped, on every track:
  KEPT as-is: format, file size, bitrate, duration, BPM, key,
    hot/memory cue positions and colors, rating, play count,
    last-played date, whether it's a streaming-service track,
    playlist membership/position, the low-resolution monochrome
    waveform preview actually used by this app, beatgrid.
  REPLACED with placeholder text (e.g. "Track 014"): title,
    artist, comment, cue comments, filename/file path,
    playlist/folder names.
  REMOVED entirely: artwork images, the detailed color and
    scrolling waveform data rekordbox's own UI uses during
    playback (not read by this app), original file paths.

Output size: 20.3 MB raw, roughly 9.8 MB estimated once zipped.

Nothing has been sent anywhere; this only wrote a single zip
file. Review its contents, then attach that zip to an email to
sebas@kde.org if you'd like to help test against your
hardware/library. This dataset may be published as part of the
project's test suite. If there's anything in the hardware or
notes text above you'd rather not have published, leave it out
here and mention it directly in your email instead. If this is
too large to attach, re-run with --max-tracks to include a
smaller sample.
